protocol.deletion_expectation: 1/2 + 1/2 * mean (1 - p)^h over positives (one path each)

kinds.delete: each edge removed with probability p
kinds.insert: r times the number of edges of absent ordered pairs added, rounded at random
kinds.reverse: each edge replaced by its reverse with probability p

purpose: how exact the reader's graph must be: pipeline accuracy under controlled reading errors
